Connect.TailscaleAdviceTitle: Not on the same local network? Use Tailscale
Connect.TailscaleAdvice: Install Tailscale on both devices and sign in to the same account to connect across networks. Tailscale does hole punching and falls back to a relay, so you need no server of your own. Once it is set up, the other device appears in the Tailscale device list.
Connect.NoRecent: You have not connected to any device yet.
Connect.Fingerprint: This Mac's fingerprint (the other person can compare it with the one they see when confirming the connection)
Connect.IntroWithId: Enter the address shown in the other person's window (a local network IP or Tailscale name) or their device ID, and the one-time code.
Connect.Intro: Enter the address shown in the other person's window (a local network IP or Tailscale name) and the one-time code.
Connect.AddressHint: Enter the other device's address: a local network IP or Tailscale name, optionally with a port (for example 192.168.1.20:47800)
Connect.IdNeedsServer: Device IDs work only after you set up a self-hosted signaling server (Advanced). To do without a server, install Tailscale on both devices and enter the other device's Tailscale name.
Connect.CodeHint: The one-time code is 8 letters or digits (2–7), for example ABCD-2345
